reasoning: Elon Musk's wealth is highly volatile, tied primarily to Tesla stock price fluctuations. As of early 2025, he competes with other ultra-wealthy individuals (Bernard Arnault, Jeff Bezos, etc.) for the top position. Tesla's valuation and Musk's other ventures (X, Neuralink, SpaceX) create significant uncertainty. His wealth can swing billions based on stock movements.
